fonts.reason: Loaded variable Vazirmatn gives the command palette a readable, neutral Persian product UI voice and reliable joining. The shortcut remains an isolated LTR token. The second composition contains no visible text, but uses the same UI family for consistency.

rtlDecisions.action: Translated to «تیره» and revealed one Persian character on each original cue at frames 38, 46, 54, and 62; inline opacity spans preserve shaping between letters.
rtlDecisions.why: The source types four characters; Persian must keep the same four beats while reading from the right.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept unchanged as an LTR isolated keyboard token at the right edge of the RTL input.
rtlDecisions.why: Keyboard notation is a universal Latin-direction token.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored both textless dashboard layers horizontally so the sidebar and UI reading order sit on the right. Kept the command panel centered at (960, 470).
rtlDecisions.why: Dashboard rail and card layout follow reading direction; preserving the center keeps the collapse point coincident with the ripple origin.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the point at (960, 470) and the circular reveal expanding uniformly with the original radius, easing, and timing.
rtlDecisions.why: The center is established by the centered panel; a circle has no reading direction and the causal anchor must remain exact.

rtlDecisions.action: Preserved all original frame cues, easing, scales, colors, and seeded skeleton geometry.
rtlDecisions.why: These define the source motion and the in-place theme change.

compositions.rasterHandling: No raster assets. Dashboards and panel are CSS geometry; there is no baked-in text.
compositions.visualVerification: Compared Persian and original at frames 38, 46, and 80; inspected consecutive Persian typing frames 38–42 and 46–48 for progressive, connected shaping.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored both light and dark dashboard layers horizontally, moving the sidebar to the right and preserving pixel-identical structure between themes.
rtlDecisions.why: The rail and card sequence communicate interface reading order. Matching geometry preserves the same-UI theme-switch effect.

rtlDecisions.what: Diagonal theme sweep and highlight edge
rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the clip polygon and highlight line so the sweep travels from upper-right toward lower-left; negated the line rotation and mirrored its x-position.
rtlDecisions.why: The sweep carries reading-direction meaning. Its 15-degree angle, easing, frame range, line glow, and settle scale remain the same.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept vertical positions, gravity-free dashboard geometry, and all timing unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: These do not encode reading direction.

compositions.rasterHandling: No raster assets or visible text. Both theme versions are CSS skeleton dashboards.
compositions.visualVerification: Compared Persian and original at frames 14, 38, 52, and 54; inspected transition and settled frames through 70 and 169.

render.durationNote: The registry reports 95 frames for PaletteThemeRipple; the source design continues to frame 170. Used the harness --duration 170 for inspection and full Persian video rendering without changing the registered duration.

concerns: The card registry truncates PaletteThemeRipple at 95 frames even though its source timeline specifies a 170-frame dark hold. The rendered video uses the source's intended 170-frame timeline via the harness duration flag; registry metadata was left unchanged.
